summary.zh: RuiC-PoseAtlas 的姿势图鉴(多机位人台线稿)与服装图鉴接进参考库:浏览、搜索,用到哪张取哪张。
summary.en: RuiC-PoseAtlas pose atlas (multi-angle mannequin line art) and costume atlas in the reference library: browse, search, take one.

help.zh: 原站的「性感」「双人」系列、上半身里的两类,以及服装的「内衣」「性感」两类。关着时这些条目根本不出现;打开后它们标为 NSFW,按预览图设置模糊或隐藏。
help.en: The site's Sexy and Couples series, two upper-body categories, and the Lingerie and Sexy costume categories. While off, these entries never appear; when on, they are marked NSFW and blurred or hidden per your preview settings.

description.zh: 替 Mosael 的参考库回答 PoseAtlas 有哪几本图集、按关键词和分类找条目、一个条目的各机位图与出处,以及把选中的那张原图取回来。图片一律从原站取,插件不带图。只给宿主调。
description.en: Answers Mosael's reference library: which atlases PoseAtlas has, finding entries by keyword and category, an entry's views and provenance, and fetching the original image the user picked. Images always come from the original site; the plugin ships none. Host-only.
